name: Panasonic PTZ cameras (AW-HE/UE series)
notes: Actions are registered per camera series (src/models.js), so not every action exists for every camera; the catalog lists the union.
Pan/tilt/zoom/focus direction actions carry a liveSpeed checkbox (the research notes had marked these options as not read).
Gain, shutter, pedestal, ND filter and colour temperature dropdowns take series-specific choice lists (seriesActions.*.dropdown in src/models.js); they are not enumerated here.
Built on @companion-module/base 1.x: options are fixed dropdown values, no expressions.
Alternative module for similar cameras: panasonic-cameras (not catalogued in detail).
